title: The Toro Company Expands Recall of Snowthrowers Posing Fire Hazard
summary: The plastic fuel tank can crack and leak gasoline, posing a risk of fire and injury. Units: About 84,000.

title: Girls' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstring Recalled for Strangulation Hazard
summary: A drawstring is threaded through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 9,700.

title: Robertshaw Controls Co. Recalls Gas Controls Installed in Commercial Cooking Appliances for Fire Hazard
summary: These controls are designed to prevent gas from flowing when the pilot light is out. The recalled controls can remain on after the pilot light is extinguished. If this happens, gas can continue to flow to the main burner of the appliance, which poses a risk of a gas explosion and fire. Units: About

title: Troy-Bilt String Trimmer Sold at Lowe's Recalled for Laceration Hazard
summary: The blade that trims the excess string of these weed trimmers can detach from the plastic shield covering the trimmer head. The blade can be thrown outward, hitting the user or bystander, resulting in a laceration. Units: About 20,000.

title: 5-Gallon Zep-Brand Cleaner, Floor Stripper Sold at Home Depot Recalled, Containers Crack and Leak Corrosive Liquids
summary: 5-gallon plastic pails containing the cleaning products can unexpectedly crack and leak from the base, posing a risk to consumers, due to the corrosive nature of these products. Units: About 6,800.

title: Cage Bell Musical Instruments for Babies Recalled for Choking Hazard
summary: If the bell inside the instrument is damaged during manufacturing, the bell can be pulled out of the instrument, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: Lands' End Children's Light-Up Backpacks Recalled for Overheating
summary: The backpack's battery pack can overheat, causing the battery case to melt, presenting a burn hazard if touched. Units: About 400.

title: Lead Poisoning Hazard Prompts Recall of Fun Express Children's Toys Given Away at Libraries
summary: The paint on the bendable toys contains excessive levels of lead, which is banned under federal law. Lead is toxic and, if ingested by young children, can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 340,000 toys.

title: Target Recalls Scooters - Various Breaking Parts Present Fall Hazard
summary: The handlebars, wheels and wheel brakes can break and detach, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer injuries. Units: About 185,000.

title: Atico International USA Recalls Folding Picnic Tables Due to Collapsing Hazard
summary: The legs on the picnic table can buckle or break during use, causing the table to collapse or fold unexpectedly. Units: About 209,000.

title: Black & Decker Expands Recall of Cordless Electric Lawnmowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical component in the lawnmowers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 160,000 mowers (140,000 of these Black & Decker and Craftsman brand lawnmowers were recalled in September 2002, but also are included in this recall).

title: Speed Buckle Harnesses Used During Mountain and Rock Climbing Recalled for Fall Hazard
summary: The harness could be threaded incorrectly. If threaded incorrectly, the webbing will easily slip when loaded. Incorrectly threaded buckles can loosen, which could cause climbers to slip out of the harness and fall. Units: About 18,000.

title: Tu-Wire® Dimming Ballasts Used With Compact Fluorescent Lights Recalled for Shock Hazard
summary: These ballasts, if not properly grounded in accordance with the National Electrical Code, can present a risk of electric shock to persons who come in contact with the ballast or with a light fixture that incorporates the ballast, such as when a consumer changes a fluorescent lamp bulb. Units: About

title: Dell Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries Due To Fire Hazard
summary: These lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 2.7 million battery packs (an additional 1.5 million battery packs were sold outside the U.S.).

title: Gotham Light Fixtures Recalled Due to Risk of Falling Parts
summary: The reflector/trim pieces may not be properly attached to each other. The lower portion of the reflector/trim assembly could detach and fall from the ceiling, striking consumers. Units: About 4,700.

title: Ballard Designs Inc. Recalls Potted Candles for Fire Hazard
summary: The packaging or holder can ignite, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 775 candles and candle sets.

title: CPSC, Brunswick Bowling & Billiards Corp. Announce Recall of Frameworx Table Height Chairs and Bar Stools
summary: The down shaft on the seat plate assembly can fracture, which can cause an occupant of the seat to fall. Units: About 22,400.

title: Children's Cooking Sets with Glass Lids Recalled for Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass pot lids can break, posing a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 4,200.

title: Dollar Tree Stores Recall Counterfeit Extension Cords Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The counterfeit extension cords could have undersized wire and substandard insulation, which can cause overheating, resulting in a possible shock hazard. Units: About 600,000.

title: Safety Alert: NRS and LL Bean Inflatable Water Boards Lack Safety Warning Labels
summary: The safety warning label containing precautionary information on proper use and operation was not affixed to the device. The safety warning label should read: "CAUTION: This is not a lifesaving device. Never leave children unattended in or near water" Units: About 700.

title: J.C. Penney Recalls Lamps For Fire Hazard
summary: The lamp's electrical circuit board can spark and overheat, due to an electrical problem, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,600.

title: Quiksilver Recalls Children's Lounge Pants Due to Burn Hazard
summary: These lounge pants fail to meet the children's sleepwear flammability standards, posing a risk of burn injury to children, due to the possible ignition of the garment. These garments were not labeled or marketed as sleepwear, but because they are children's loungewear, they must meet the children's

title: ElectroPlasma Lamps Sold at Spencer Gifts Stores Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: Arcing between an object and the removable cover of the lamp can pose a fire hazard. Units: About 1,500.

title: Pool Toys Recalled by Wild Planet Toys Due to Risk of Impalement Injury to Children
summary: When partially filled with water, the pool toy can stand upright on the pool floor with the rigid narrow end pointed upward, posing an impalement risk. Units: About 273,000.

title: Agio International's Outdoor Steel Dome Fireplaces Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Touch-up paint used on the fireplace's exterior can ignite during use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 33,800.

title: Deere & Company Recalls Lawn Tractors, Blade Could Operate While Mower Unattended
summary: A problem in the manufacturing process could cause damage to the circuit in the interlock module. If the interlock module fails, the mower blades will be able to run with no operator on the tractor seat. Consumers could suffer injuries from contact with operating blades. Units: About 16,000.

title: Milano Stools Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled stools can be unstable due to missing screws, loose screws or wrongly sized screws, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,800.

title: Syratech Corporation Recalls Elements® Decorative Lawn Sprinklers
summary: The plastic body of the lawn sprinkler can crack when placed under intense water pressure and pieces of it can break off and be projected 5 to 10 feet in the air. This could pose a risk of injury to consumers and bystanders. Units: About 10,000.

title: Apple Announces Recall of Batteries Used in Previous iBook and PowerBook Computers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: These lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.1 million battery packs (an additional 700,000 battery packs were sold outside the U.S.).

title: Blount International Inc. Recalls Replacement Blades for Use with Snapper Riding Lawnmowers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: When the lawnmower is operated, the replacement blade can crack and pieces can break away, posing a serious laceration hazard to consumers and bystanders. Units: About 94,000.

title: ITT Water Technology Inc. Recalls Faulty Pumps for Fire Suppression Systems
summary: A mechanical part on these pumps was not fully tightened, which can lead to the pump failing during use. If pumps sold with fire suppression systems fail, the risk of fire damage increases. The pump itself does not pose a fire hazard. Units: About 18,300.

title: Weightlifting Bars Recalled by York Barbell Co. After Reports of Units Breaking
summary: Due to a defect in the sleeve mechanism, the bar can break under the pressure of significant weight, which could injure consumers and bystanders. Units: About 3,300.

title: School Specialty Publishing Recalls Children's Science Kits for Thermal Burn Hazard
summary: The battery case in the science kit can overheat, posing a thermal burn hazard. Units: About 43,000.

title: Spin Master Radio-Controlled Toy Airplanes Sold Exclusively at Toys R Us Recalled for Burn Hazard
summary: The rechargeable battery pack inside the toy airplane can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 7,500.
